Crop rectangle <code>(138, 610, 1301, 2236)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>bf326975c7eb9adfff9c76dcfb4b97bb62ac338d63277abbe9b7731e51a4ef57</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
